//

// -fspv-debug=vulkan-with-source the shader text is embedded in the module, so a

float4 g_color;



float4 main(float4 pos : SV_Position) : SV_Target {

  float4 acc = g_color;

  for (int i = 0; i < 2; ++i) {

    acc = acc * 0.5f + pos;

  }

  return acc;

}
